lines.text: Mercury. Dayside hits about 430 degrees Celsius; nightside falls to minus 180. Almost no atmosphere to hold the heat.
Heat vents and falling rocks ahead. Tap E to fire the blaster, and jump on anything that crawls too close.
Solar Panel Array secured. The return pod is primed - get to the ship.
Panel stowed. Mercury's solar output is unreal - this alone could run our whole ship.
Heat vents erupt in a rhythm. Watch the pulse, then run through.
Meteors fall where the sky flashes. Keep moving under open rock.
Stomp or shoot the crawlers, and never stand in a vent's shadow.
